goal: turn a ready Scout handoff into a mechanically valid candidate patch without mutating the repository
gates: ready handoff produces an applicable in-memory patch while source bytes stay unchanged
partial or blocked handoff has no patch authority
files outside the Scout handoff cannot enter the candidate patch
exact replacement preconditions must match exactly once
syntax-breaking candidates are rejected by the existing ast-grep/tree-sitter backend
edits farther than 96 lines from carried Scout evidence are rejected
